description: This file defines the 'Number' class in the SCSSPHP library, representing SCSS dimension values with units and performing operations like addition, subtraction, comparison, and unit conversion.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: Represents a numerical value with optional units, providing methods for arithmetic operations, unit handling, comparison, and serialization within the SCSSPHP library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Number instance with a value, numerator units, and optional denominator units.

methods.name: getDimension
methods.description: Returns the numerical dimension value.

methods.name: getNumeratorUnits
methods.description: Returns the list of numerator units.

methods.name: getDenominatorUnits
methods.description: Returns the list of denominator units.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the Number instance to JSON, outputting its string representation.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a given offset (property index) exists (e.g., source line, column, or internal properties).

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a given offset (property index).

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Throws an exception as Number instances are immutable.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Throws an exception as Number instances are immutable.

methods.name: unitless
methods.description: Returns true if the number has no units.

methods.name: hasUnits
methods.description: Returns true if the number has any units.

methods.name: hasUnit
methods.description: Checks whether the number has exactly the specified unit.

methods.name: unitStr
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number's units.

methods.name: valueInRange
methods.description: Checks whether the number's value is within a specified range.

methods.name: valueInRangeWithUnit
methods.description: Checks whether the number's value is within a specified range with a specific unit.

methods.name: assertNoUnits
methods.description: Throws an exception if the number has units, or passes if unitless.

methods.name: assertUnit
methods.description: Throws an exception if the number does not have the specified unit.

methods.name: assertSameUnitOrUnitless
methods.description: Checks whether another Number has the same units or is unitless.

methods.name: coerce
methods.description: Returns a copy of the number converted to specified units.

methods.name: isComparableTo
methods.description: Determines if the number is comparable to another number (e.g., compatible units).

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Checks if the number is less than another number.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the number is less than or equal to another number.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Checks if the number is greater than another number.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the number is greater than or equal to another number.

methods.name: plus
methods.description: Adds another number, returning a new Number instance.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Subtracts another number, returning a new Number instance.

methods.name: unaryMinus
methods.description: Returns the negation of the number.

methods.name: modulo
methods.description: Calculates the modulo with another number.

methods.name: times
methods.description: Multiplies the number with another number.

methods.name: dividedBy
methods.description: Divides the number by another number.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks whether the number equals another number, considering units.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number, optionally with units, suitable for CSS or Sass output.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number.
